notes.title: ✨️Dev Update✨️
notes.notes:
📣 DEV UPDATE: 135 Players & 8 Hours Average Playtime — You’re Incredible 





Hey Seekers 👋 



I just wanted to take a moment to say thank you — Seekers: Enlightenment now has 135 unique players, and you're averaging nearly 8 hours of playtime each. That’s wild. 



🎮 A huge shoutout to the folks replaying the game, pushing through Time Attack, and coming back for more — you're the heart of this game.





--- 



⚔️ What’s Next? 



I’m currently working on: 



Daily challenges - it will change the way you play the game 



Chaos Trials Mode – A whole new layer of challenge. 



Chapter 2 DLC – 20+ levels of new content coming soon.



Chapter 2 dlc content - new characters for chaos trials l, new skins, and new characters for chaos trials!



The goal is to reward those of you who stuck around, and give new players even more reasons to explore deeper.





--- 



💬 Want to Help? 



Leave a review – even just a few words helps a lot 



Share the game – with a friend, streamer, or community 



Tell me what you’d love to see next – I’m always listening





Thank you for being here. Your support means everything — we’re just getting started!



🌀 —Mega Morph Games

Solo Dev of Seekers : Enlightenment

notes.title: Seekers: Enlightenment (Bug fixes)
notes.notes: * When using ivy's ability "Dash" her stamina wouldn't regenerate at all but now the player regains their stamina back after using one of the abilities that Ivy has

notes.title: Seekers: Enlightenment Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
* In chapter 1 Level 5 in the story the player can now skip the cutscene when previously the player couldn't skip the cutscene

* The player can't use dash while wall sliding when the player could before which would waste Ivy's Stamina.

*Fixed the conditions to get the "What did I get myself Into" Achievement.
